To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Fe3O4 @Mg-MOF nanoparticles are used as a novel magnetic solid-phase extraction material for the selective capture of glycopeptide biomarkers from human serum.

Fe3O4 nanoparticles are coated with the Mg-MOF-14 MOF to create a core-shell structure with excellent hydrophilicity and a size-exclusion effect, which allows for the efficient capture of glycoproteins from serum samples.
we have developed a facile and highly efficient method to enrich glycopeptides from human serum using magnetic Fe3O4 @Mg-MOF core-shell nanospheres.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the preparation of Fe3O4 @Mg-MOF nanoparticles with excellent performance for glycopeptide enrichment and the development of an effective method for glycoprotein analysis in biological samples.
the preparation and characterization of Fe3O4 @ Mg-MOF- 74 core-shell nanoparticles for the selective enrichment of N-linked glycopeptides in serum.
the development of a facile, effective and selective enrichment method for the analysis of N-glycoproteins from serum.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this study has demonstrated that the developed Fe3O4 @Mg-MOF nanoparticles can be used for the enrichment of N-linked glycopeptides from complex biological samples, such as serum.

the developed Fe3O4-MOF core-shell nanoparticles have been successfully used for the enrichment and isolation of glycopeptides from a complex biological sample, and that the method is highly efficient, simple, and fast.
the Fe3O 4@Mg- MOF-74 core-shell nanospheres are a powerful tool for enriching N-glycoproteins and their glycopeptides in complex samples.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Fe3O 4@Mg- MOF-74 core-shell nanospheres are highly efficient and selective for the enrichment of glycopeptides from human serum.
the core-shell nanoparticles are capable of capturing glycopeptides in a highly efficient manner, which is of importance for glycoproteomic research.
Fe3O4 core-shell nanoparticles with MOF shell have been facilely synthesized, and the resultant Fe3O4 nanoparticles have shown highly efficient capture of N-glycopeptides from serum.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the Fe3O@Mg-MO-74 core-shell nanomaterial can provide a promising platform for highly efficient capture and enrichment of glycopeptides from complex biological fluids.
a new class of metal–organic frameworks (MOFs) with hydrophilic pore surfaces can be utilized for efficient and specific glycoprotein enrichment.
Fe3O4 @Mg-MOF -74 core-shell nanoparticles can be a highly efficient and selective enrichment material for N-glycopeptides in human serum.
